units.source: {#1}Battle Brothers{/#1} is a turn based tactical RPG that puts you in command of a mercenary company in medieval fantasy world. The player decides where his company goes, whom to hire or dismiss, whom to fight or align with, and ultimately has to deal with consequences of every action.
units.zh: {#1}《战场兄弟》{/#1}是一款回合制战术角色扮演游戏。你将在中世纪奇幻世界中率领一支佣兵战团，决定前往何处、招募或解雇谁、与谁交战或结盟，并承担每个决定带来的后果。

units.source: The event has a 40% chance to fail to produce a masterwork bow, you will get a {#1}wonky bow{/#1} instead. You can get this event only once per campaign, no matter if you failed or succeded crafting the bow.

units.source: The bowmaker will have negative morale for a day or two in response to his failure at making a good weapon. To add insult to injury, the Wonky Bow will be named after the maker, so you never forget who messed up.

units.source: {#1}A large and heavy crossbow with menacing spikes in front. More like a miniature ballista, it shoots stakes with enough force to knock back a target hit.{/#1}

units.source: Spiked Impaler will Knock Back the hit target one tile backwards in a straight line (or diagonally) if the target is not blocked from behind (and sideways) by units or obstacles such as rocks, trees, etc.

units.source: A shield hit is not considered a target hit, but regarded as a miss.

units.source: A Knock Back will cancel Shieldwall, Spearwall, Riposte skill from the hit target.
units.zh: 击退会取消目标的盾墙、矛墙和还击架势。

units.source: Opponents with Stalwart passive ability are immune to Knock Back.
units.zh: 拥有坚毅被动能力的敌人免疫击退。

units.source: Flails are extremely useful {#1}weapons{/#1} to new companies due to their ability to bypass shields and target the often-unarmored head of a pesky brigand.
units.zh: 连枷能绕过盾牌，专打强盗经常不戴头盔的脑袋，因此对新战团来说，是非常实用的{#1}武器{/#1}。

units.source: On top of a general bonus of +10% chance to hit the head, flails also have a "Lash/Hail" attack. Lash/Hail can be a devastating attack against enemies with little head gear, because when it hits, it guarantees a head hit and therefore critical damage.
units.zh: 除了自带 +10% 头部命中率，连枷还拥有“鞭打／雹击”。这类攻击只要命中，就必定打中头部并造成暴击伤害，对头部防护薄弱的敌人威胁极大。

units.source: Flails ignore the defense bonus granted by shields with their basic "Flail/Cascade" attack, whereas the "Lash/Hail" attack will only do so if the {#1}Flail Mastery Perk{/#1} is picked.
units.zh: 连枷的普通“连枷挥击／连环抽击”会无视盾牌提供的防御加成；“鞭打／雹击”则只有在学习{#1}连枷精通{/#1}后，才能无视盾牌加成。

units.source: If you take {#1}Mastery Perk{/#1}, Thresh will gain +5% chance to hit.
units.zh: 学习{#1}连枷精通{/#1}后，横扫的命中率获得 +5% 加成。

units.source: Bows use ammo from an equipped arrow quiver. One quiver can hold a maximum of 10 ammo (14 for crafted quiver). Every mercenary can carry 1 quiver in a special item slot, and, just like a regular item, it can be dropped on the ground. Ammo for quivers is automatically refilled after combat from your global ammo stockpile.
units.zh: 弓使用已装备箭袋里的弹药。普通箭袋最多容纳 10 支箭，制作所得的版本可装 14 支。每名佣兵可在专用栏位携带 1 个箭袋，也能像普通物品一样把它丢到地上。战斗结束后，箭袋会自动从战团弹药储备中补充。

units.source: Bows' range is affected by height level difference between archer and its target. Shooting downhill increases range by 1 for each height level above target; opposite effect is applied for uphill shooting. Also see {#1}Vision{/#1}.
units.zh: 弓手与目标之间的高度差会影响射程。向低处射击时，每高出目标一个高度等级，射程增加 1 格；向高处射击则相反。另见{#1}视野{/#1}。

units.source: View range and maximum firing range with bows is increased by 1.
units.zh: 视野和弓的最大射程各增加 1 格。

units.source: Allies at a range of 4 tiles or less receive 10% of the Resolve of the character holding this standard as a bonus, up to a maximum of the standard bearer's Resolve.
units.zh: 距离旗手不超过 4 格的友军，获得相当于旗手意志 10% 的意志加成；加成后最高不超过旗手本人的意志。

units.source: This buff lasts for the entire turn even when the standard has been swapped for another weapon.
units.zh: 即使把战旗换成其他武器，这项增益仍会持续到本次行动结束。

units.source: Can be found in the {#1}Wildman Finds Something{/#1}, {#2}Greenskins Investigation{/#2} events.
units.zh: 可在{#1}荒野人发现物品{/#1}、{#2}绿皮入侵：调查{/#2}事件中获得。

units.source: Frequent use can result in gaining {#1}Addict{/#1} trait, {#2}Addict Steals Potion{/#2} and tragic {#3}Alp Nightmare 2{/#3} events.
units.zh: 频繁使用可能获得{#1}药瘾{/#1}特性，并引发{#2}药瘾者偷药{/#2}以及结局惨烈的{#3}梦魇噩梦 2{/#3}事件。

units.source: "Consumables" are items which once used, in combat or on global map, will entirely disappear.
units.zh: 消耗品是在战斗中或世界地图上使用后，会完全消失的物品。

units.source: Damage is dealt every turn for a duration of 3 turns
units.zh: 每回合造成伤害，持续 3 回合。

units.source: Has a 33% chance to hit bystanders at the same or lower height level
units.zh: 有 33% 的概率波及位于相同或更低高度的旁邻单位。

units.source: Can be consistently gained in the {#1}Monk Crafts Holy Water{/#1} events.
units.zh: 可通过{#1}修士制作圣水{/#1}事件反复获得。

units.source: Can be obtained at the {#1}Ancient Temple{/#1} legendary location.
units.zh: 可在传奇地点{#1}古庙{/#1}获得。

units.source: Damage is dealt on impact, so it instantly kills a {#1}Geist{/#1}.
units.zh: 命中时就会立即造成伤害，因此能直接杀死{#1}怨魂{/#1}。

units.source: Carried in offhand in shield slot. Shield slot is free again after usage.
units.zh: 装备在副手的盾牌栏中，使用后盾牌栏会重新空出。

units.source: Can be crafted at a {#1}Taxidermist{/#1} from {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} {#5}Lindwurm Blood{/#5} for 50 {#6}{#7}{#8/}{/#7}{/#6}.
Reduces the affected target's current body and head armor value by 20%.
units.zh: 使受影响目标当前的身体护甲与头部护甲值降低 20%。

units.source: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Bone Platings{/#4} armor attachment protects the body armor for 1 turn.
{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Lindwurm Scale Cloak{/#4} armor attachment negates effect for the body armor.
units.zh: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}林德蠕龙鳞披风{/#4}附件可免除身体护甲受到的酸液影响。

units.source: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Lindwurm Armor{/#4} and {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}Lindwurm Helmet{/#8} are completely unaffected by the acid.
Can be used while engaged in melee, although risking possible collateral armor damage.
units.zh: 近战接敌时也能使用，但可能误伤周围单位的护甲。

units.source: Roots a target in place, preventing movement and Rotation
units.zh: 将目标困在原地，使其无法移动或换位。

units.source: Removing a {#1}Throwing Net{/#1} is based on melee skill and initially has -10 points penalty
units.zh: 挣脱{#1}捕网{/#1}以近战命中属性进行检定，初始受到 -10 点惩罚。

units.source: Each failed attempt to {#1}Break Free{/#1} or {#2}Free Ally{/#2} will give +10 points to remove the net
units.zh: 每次{#1}挣脱{/#1}或{#2}解救队友{/#2}失败，后续解除捕网的检定都会获得 +10 点加成。

units.source: {#1}A net is used to throw over a target in order to hamper their ability to move and defend themself effectively.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}将捕网投向目标，使其难以移动，也难以有效防御。{/#1}

units.source: Can be commonly bought at a {#1}Marketplace{/#1} in settlements with Harbor (attached location).
units.zh: 设有港口附属地点的聚落，其{#1}集市{/#1}较常出售捕网。

units.source: Can be commonly bought at a {#1}Marketplace{/#1} in southern city states.
units.zh: 南方城邦的{#1}集市{/#1}较常出售捕网。

units.source: Can be looted from {#1}Goblin Skirmisher{/#1}, {#2}Mercenary{/#2}, {#3}Bounty Hunter{/#3}, {#4}Gladiator{/#4} (in combat).
Can be gained in the {#1}Ratcatcher Crafts Net{/#1}, {#2}Lucky Finds Something{/#2} events.
units.zh: 可在{#1}捕鼠人制作捕网{/#1}、{#2}幸运佣兵发现物品{/#2}事件中获得。

units.source: Can be used to save a {#1}Wardog{/#1} in the {#2}Dog in Swamp{/#2} event.
units.zh: 可在{#2}沼泽里的狗{/#2}事件中，用于救出{#1}战犬{/#1}。

units.source: {#1}A heavy and tarnished scale coat of ancient design that belongs into a collection, not on the battlefield.{/#1} [sic]
units.zh: {#1}一件沉重、失去光泽的古代重鳞甲衣。它更该待在收藏室里，而非战场上。{/#1}［原文如此］

units.source: Can be gained in the {#1}Civilwar Wounded Soldier{/#1} event.
units.zh: 可在{#1}贵族战争：伤兵{/#1}事件中获得。

units.source: Can be gained in the events: {#1}Lucky Finds Something{/#1}, {#2}Dogs Dig up Loot{/#2}.
units.zh: 可在{#1}幸运佣兵发现物品{/#1}和{#2}战犬挖出战利品{/#2}事件中获得。

units.source: Possible starting weapon of new mercenaries: {#1}Gladiator{/#1}, {#2}Hedge Knight{/#2}, {#3}Oathtaker{/#3}.
units.zh: 以下新招募佣兵可能自带此装备：{#1}角斗士{/#1}、{#2}流浪骑士{/#2}、{#3}立誓者{/#3}。

units.source: {#1}Mace Mastery{/#1} perk does not reduce Fatigue build up of the {#2}Split Shield{/#2} skill, nor increase the Direct damage to shields.
units.zh: {#1}钉锤精通{/#1}不会降低{#2}破盾{/#2}技能的疲劳消耗，也不会提高对盾牌的直接伤害。

units.source: {#1}Strike Down{/#1} stun duration is reduced to 1 turn, if enemy possesses {#2}Resilient{/#2} perk (and has no stun effect on immune enemies).
units.zh: 如果敌人拥有{#2}顽强{/#2}特长，{#1}重击击晕{/#1}造成的眩晕会缩短为 1 回合；对免疫眩晕的敌人则完全无效。

units.source: The Taxidermist is a Settlement Building that allows the player to craft new items out of beast parts and other items.
units.zh: 剥制工坊是一种聚落建筑，可以用野兽素材及其他物品制作新物品。

units.source: In order to create the item, the player must visit a non-hostile town during daylight, and have the materials and gold cost available. The materials will be removed and the item put in the player's inventory.
units.zh: 制作时，玩家需在白天进入非敌对城镇，并备齐所需材料与克朗。完成后，材料会被消耗，成品则放入战团物品栏。

units.source: The recipes start invisible to the player until they own at least enough materials to craft a recipe. In that moment, it becomes visible.
units.zh: 配方起初不会显示。只有当玩家拥有足够材料，可以制作某个配方时，该配方才会出现。

units.source: If the player crafts any item, that particular recipe will be remembered and shown for the reminder of the playthrough, even if the player no longer has enough materials. In that case, the crafting recipe will be crossed out but will still inform the player of the materials (and amounts) they are missing.
units.zh: 一旦制作过某件物品，对应配方便会被记住，在本轮战役余下时间持续显示，即使后来材料不足也一样。此时配方会被划去，但仍会列出缺少哪些材料以及相应数量。

units.source: {#1}NOTE:{/#1} {#2}The Taxidermist is only available with the 'Beasts & Exploration' DLC.{/#2}
units.zh: {#1}注意：{/#1}{#2}剥制工坊仅在安装《野兽与探索》DLC 后开放。{/#2}

units.source: For necklaces made out of Trophies, see {#1}Trophy Necklaces{/#1}.
units.zh: 由战利品制成的项链，见{#1}战利品项链{/#1}。

units.source: Trophies are items that can be looted from slain monsters. They can be sold for a fraction of their worth or taken to the {#1}Taxidermist{/#1} to {#2}craft{/#2} new items. Hiring the {#3}follower Alchemist{/#3} allows crafting cost-efficient {#4}Snake Oil{/#4}.
units.zh: 战利材料可从被杀死的怪物身上缴获。它们可以按标示价值的一部分出售，也可以带到{#1}剥制工坊{/#1}{#2}制作{/#2}新物品。招募{#3}随行炼金术士{/#3}后，还能制作收益较好的{#4}蛇油{/#4}。

units.zh: 聚落和南方城邦的{#1}武器匠{/#1}有较低概率出售。

units.source: Lunge works by applying a damage multiplier based on the bro's current initiative. at 89 initiative, lunge will do the base damage of the weapon. Below 89 initiative, you'll incur a damage penalty vs using slash. Above 89 initiative, damage will be increased. The maximum multiplier is 2x and this cap is reached at 175 initiative.
units.zh: 突进会根据队员当前的先攻，为伤害施加倍率。先攻为 89 时，伤害等于武器基础伤害；低于 89 时，伤害比挥斩更低；高于 89 时，伤害会增加。最高倍率为 2 倍，在先攻达到 175 时取得。

units.source: Stinger, Flurry, Thorn, Pincer, Edge, Striker, Blade, Heartseeker, Bloodspiller, Gapcloser, Grace, Swiftblade
units.zh: 蜇人蜂、疾风连击、荆棘、钳击者、锋芒、打击者、锋刃、觅心者、洒血者、迫近者、优雅、迅捷之刃

units.source: Note: As per version 1.2.0.19 there is no modification on the Initiative scaling on famed fencing swords. Nor has there been previously. Being technically a weapon stat although hidden might make players think it may be variable as well. But testing proves that it sadly does not.
units.zh: 版本说明：截至原文所述的 1.2.0.19 版本，名贵刺剑的先攻伤害倍率并不会随机变化，此前也从未变化。虽然这在技术上属于隐藏的武器属性，容易让玩家以为它也能随机浮动，但原文测试结果表明并非如此。

units.zh: 可向{#1}制甲师{/#1}购买，南方城邦不出售。

units.source: {#1}A metal sallet helmet with an extended neckguard, a design uncommon in these lands. It is well crafted to offer maximum protection with minimum weight and without impairing vision.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}一顶带加长护颈的金属萨莱特盔，在这片土地上并不常见。精良的工艺让它以较轻的重量提供出色防护，同时不妨碍视野。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Hammer Mastery{/#1} perk removes accuracy penalty for hitting adjacent targets.
units.zh: {#1}战锤精通{/#1}会消除攻击相邻目标时的命中惩罚。

units.source: {#1}Fearsome{/#1} perk allows morale checks on every hit. Be advised that not every morale check leads to a morale drop.
units.zh: {#1}威慑{/#1}能让每次命中都触发士气检定；请注意，检定并不一定导致士气下降。

units.zh: 可在{#1}偶遇葬礼{/#1}事件中获得。

units.zh: 执行{#2}猎杀女巫{/#2}委托时，可在{#1}女巫的交易：长子的性命{/#1}事件中获得。

units.source: Unlike the {#1}Water Skin{/#1}, does not remove potion sickness including sickness from Anatomist potions.
units.zh: 无法像{#1}皮水囊{/#1}那样清除服药导致的患病，包括解剖学者药剂引起的患病。

units.source: {#1}Traded for with a malevolent witch at the expense of another man's life, this mysterious concoction promises to be a magical drink for the spirit, and grant wisdom and insight as if having fought a dozen battles.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}这瓶神秘药剂，是以他人的性命为代价，从恶毒女巫手中换来的。据说饮下后能滋养精神，带来仿佛经历过十余场战斗的智慧与洞见。{/#1}

units.source: Will remove all temporary or permanent injuries, as well as the Old, Addicted, Exhausted and Hangover traits and status effects.
units.zh: 移除所有暂时伤势与永久伤势，并清除年迈、药瘾、精疲力竭及宿醉等特性或状态。

units.source: Can be used on a {#1}Swordmaster{/#1} to remove his {#2}Old{/#2} trait and prevent him from {#3}aging{/#3} again.
units.zh: 可给{#1}剑术大师{/#1}使用，移除其{#2}年迈{/#2}特性，并防止他再次{#3}衰老{/#3}。

units.source: Can also be used in a {#1}Cultist{/#1} origin to remove Brain Damage from a brother (as well as any other {#2}Permanent Injuries{/#2} acquired while trying to give him Brain Damage) after {#3}converting{/#3} him. Particularly useful for powerful brothers with the {#4}Survivor{/#4} trait, even on Ironman, where you can throw them into the meat grinder over and over in order to be able to convert them. With the Water Skin it won't matter how many other debilitating injuries they acquire before finally getting Brain Damage.
units.zh: 在{#1}邪教徒{/#1}起源中，也可先让队员受到脑损伤，再将其{#3}转化为教徒{/#3}，最后用皮水囊清除脑损伤，以及此前为获得脑损伤而积累的其他{#2}永久伤势{/#2}。这对具有{#4}幸存者{/#4}特性的强力队员尤其有用：即便在铁人模式中，也能让他们反复承受濒死风险，以获得转化所需的条件。有了皮水囊，就不用担心他们在最终获得脑损伤前，还留下了多少其他致残伤势。

units.source: Can be used to remove the stacking sickness duration from taking multiple Anatomist potions from the {#1}Anatomist origin{/#1}.
units.zh: 可清除{#1}解剖学者起源{/#1}中连续服用多种药剂所叠加的患病时间。

units.zh: 除了每天带来 15 {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}克朗，它没有其他用途；如果愿意，也可以直接卖掉。

units.source: This item counts towards the requirement of hiring {#1}Bounty Hunter{/#1}
units.zh: 此物会计入招募{#1}赏金猎人随从{/#1}的条件。

units.zh: 挣脱{#1}强化捕网{/#1}以近战命中属性进行检定，初始受到 -25 点惩罚。

units.source: Each failed attempt to {#1}Break Free{/#1} or {#2}Free Ally{/#2} will give +10 points to remove the net.
units.zh: 每次{#1}挣脱{/#1}或{#2}解救队友{/#2}失败，后续解除捕网的检定都会获得 +10 点加成。

units.source: {#1}Schrats{/#1}, {#2}Geists{/#2} and some bosses are immune to being rooted. {#3}Alps{/#3}, on the contrary, can't free themselves from a net.
units.zh: {#1}树妖{/#1}、{#2}怨魂{/#2}和部分首领免疫定身。相反，{#3}梦魇{/#3}一旦中网，就无法自行挣脱。

units.source: Coats any weapon, including bare fists, with strong {#1}Webknecht Poison{/#1} (multiple weapons can be used while vial is active)
units.zh: 为任何武器附上强效{#1}巨蛛毒液{/#1}，包括徒手攻击；毒液生效期间可以切换使用多种武器。

units.source: {#1}Poisoned{/#1} status effect: drains 10 {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} at the end of affected target's turn (lasts 3 turns)
Can be obtained in the {#1}Corpses in Forest{/#1} event.
units.zh: 可在{#1}森林中的尸体{/#1}事件中获得。

units.source: {#1}Duration{/#1}: 3 turns; 1 turn for {#2}Resilient{/#2} enemies; no effect on immune enemies.
units.zh: {#1}持续时间{/#1}：3 回合；对拥有{#2}顽强{/#2}的敌人仅持续 1 回合；对免疫中毒的敌人无效。

units.source: {#1}Be quick as a cat! This potion promises to heighten your senses, and sharpen your reflexes.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}像猫一样敏捷！这瓶药剂据说能增强感官，让反应更加迅速。{/#1}

units.source: Frequent use of potions can result in gaining {#1}Addict{/#1} trait, {#2}Addict Steals Potion{/#2} and tragic {#3}Alp Nightmare 2{/#3} events.
units.zh: 频繁服药可能获得{#1}药瘾{/#1}特性，并引发{#2}药瘾者偷药{/#2}以及结局惨烈的{#3}梦魇噩梦 2{/#3}事件。

units.source: {#1}A drink to numb the pain and get the juices flowing. Expect a major burning sensation in your throat.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}一剂让痛觉麻木、让身体重新振作的饮品。喝下去时，喉咙会像着火一样。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Be brave as a lion! This potion promises to turn fear into courage, and a wimpy peasant into a knight of the realm.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}像雄狮一样勇敢！这瓶药剂据说能化恐惧为勇气，让懦弱的农民也拥有王国骑士般的胆魄。{/#1}

units.source: Grants {#1}Night Vision (Status Effect){/#1}, which make user unaffected by {#2}Nighttime (Status Effect){/#2} penalties
units.zh: 获得{#1}夜视（状态效果）{/#1}，使使用者不受{#2}夜间（状态效果）{/#2}的惩罚。

units.source: {#1}This elixir, when consumed, brightens up the night like if it were the mid of day.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}饮下这瓶灵药，黑夜也会如同正午般明亮。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}A fatigued fighter is a dead fighter. This concoction of various stimulants promises to help catch one's wind.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}力竭的战士就是死战士。这剂由多种兴奋成分调配而成的药水，据说能让人重新缓过劲来。{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Better not ask how this concoction of the rarest and most bizarre ingredients tastes! Anybody who drinks this is said to be able to relive his life, changing the decisions he made along the way..{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}最好别问这剂由最稀有、最古怪材料调成的药水是什么味道！据说，饮下它的人能重新走过自己的人生，改变一路上做过的选择……{/#1}

units.source: If you have the {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Gifted{/#4} {#5}perk{/#5} you get to keep the stats gained from gifted after removing it with the potion.
units.zh: 如果你学过{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}天赋异禀{/#4}{#5}特长{/#5}，用药剂移除它后，仍会保留它已经提供的属性。

units.source: Treats all {#1}Temporary Injuries{/#1} of a mercenary (equivalent of Temple treatment)
units.zh: 为佣兵的所有{#1}暂时伤势{/#1}提供治疗，效果相当于在神殿接受治疗。

units.source: Doesn't shorten the duration of the {#1}Sick{/#1} 'injury', which also cannot be 'treated' in the Temple. But {#2}The Surgeon{/#2} decreases sickness duration down to 1-2 days.
units.zh: 不会缩短{#1}患病{/#1}的持续时间，神殿同样无法“治疗”这种状态。不过，{#2}外科医生{/#2}能将其持续时间缩短至 1-2 天。

units.source: Improves the mood of a brother by a large amount
units.zh: 大幅改善一名佣兵的心情。

units.source: Your {#1}Reputation{/#1} reflects how people in the world judge your mercenary company to conduct itself based on past actions. Do you show mercy to your enemies? Do you burn down farmsteads and massacre the peasantry? Based on your {#2}Reputation{/#2}, people may offer you different kinds of contracts, and both contracts and events may play out differently.
units.zh: {#1}声誉{/#1}反映世人根据战团以往行为，对其处事方式作出的评价。你会对敌人手下留情吗？会烧毁农庄、屠杀农民吗？不同的{#2}声誉{/#2}会影响可接到的委托类型，也可能改变委托和事件的发展。

units.source: Crown of the South, Desert Crest, Turban of the Sun, Golden Crest, Vizier's Pride, Helm of the Sand King, Scorpion's Helm, Sun Veil, Gilder's Pride, Gilder's Visage
units.zh: 南境之冠、沙漠冠饰、烈日头巾、黄金冠饰、维齐尔之傲、沙王之盔、天蝎之盔、日光面纱、镀金者之傲、镀金者之容

units.source: The alchemist is always ready to offer a variety of exotic and dangerous alchemical contraptions at a reasonable price.
units.zh: 炼金工坊随时供应各种奇异而危险的炼金制品，价格公道。

units.source: Can be obtained in the {#1}Captured Oathbringer{/#1}, {#2}Oathtaker Joins{/#2} events.
units.zh: 可在{#1}被俘的誓约使者{/#1}、{#2}立誓者加入{/#2}事件中获得。

units.source: {#1}This fantastic concoction is the pinnacle of what research on human anatomy has yielded. The few that know of its existence claim that to consume it is to ascend to a higher state of being, something beyond a mere human.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}这剂奇妙的药液，是人体解剖研究的巅峰成果。极少数知晓其存在的人声称，服下它便能超越凡人，升华为更高层次的存在。{/#1}

units.source: Begin the game with one as part of the {#1}Anatomists{/#1} origin.
units.zh: 选择{#1}解剖学者{/#1}开局时，初始拥有一瓶。

units.source: Unlike the other {#1}Anatomists{/#1} potions there is no way to regain this if you lose it
units.zh: 与其他{#1}解剖学者{/#1}药剂不同，这瓶药剂一旦丢失，就无法再次获得。

units.source: An additional{#1} 5% {/#1}of damage ignores armour when using melee weapons
units.zh: 使用近战武器时，额外{#1}5%{/#1}的伤害无视护甲。

units.source: {#1}This draft, synthesised from the faint ectoplasmic remnants of a 'slain' Geist, alters the body of whoever imbibes itto take on a similar ghostly aspect. Any weapons wielded by such a warrior will surely gain some of the creature's ability to bypass armour! Auditory hallucinations are an expected side effect of consuming the draft and will likely cease after a while. Hopefully, anyway.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}这剂药液用被“杀死”的怨魂所余下的微量灵质制成，能改变饮用者的身体，使其也带上幽灵般的特质。这样的战士所挥舞的任何武器，想必都能获得些许怨魂穿透护甲的能力！饮用后出现幻听属于预期中的副作用，过些时候大概就会消失。至少，希望如此。{/#1}

units.source: Playing as the {#1}Anatomists{/#1} origin slay a {#2}Geist{/#2} for the first time.
units.zh: 以{#1}解剖学者{/#1}起源游玩时，首次击杀{#2}怨魂{/#2}后获得。

units.source: You can only have one of this potion, though if the brother who drank it is killed you can acquire another
units.zh: 同一时间只能拥有一份这种药剂的效果或库存；服用它的佣兵若被杀死，便可再次获得一瓶。

units.source: The threshold to sustain injuries on getting hit is increased by {#1} 33% {/#1}
units.zh: 遭受攻击时，触发伤势所需的伤害阈值提高{#1}33%{/#1}。

units.source: {#1}When consumed, this powerful concotion alters the flesh to react immediately to sudden blows, protecting the body from severe injury! Don't mind the smell that's just a sign of its potency.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}服下这剂强效药液后，血肉会在突遭击打时立即作出反应，保护身体免受重伤！别在意那股气味，那恰好证明了它药效强劲。{/#1}

units.source: Playing as the {#1}Anatomists{/#1} origin slay a {#2}Wiederganger{/#2} for the first time.
units.zh: 以{#1}解剖学者{/#1}起源游玩时，首次击杀{#2}行尸{/#2}后获得。

units.source: {#1}As any experienced beast hunter could tell you, what makes the overgrown arachnids known as Webknechts truly fearsome is their viscious poison. Well, no longer! Whoever drinks this potion need not fear the creatures venom again!{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}任何有经验的猎兽者都会告诉你，被称为巨蛛的硕大蛛形怪物，真正可怕的是那凶猛的毒液。但现在不必担心了！服下这瓶药剂的人，再也不用畏惧这种生物的毒素！{/#1}

units.source: Playing as the {#1}Anatomists{/#1} origin slay a {#2}Webknecht{/#2} for the first time.
units.zh: 以{#1}解剖学者{/#1}起源游玩时，首次击杀{#2}巨蛛{/#2}后获得。

units.source: You can only have one of this potion, though if the brother who drank it was killed you can acquire another
units.zh: 同一时间只能拥有一份这种药剂的效果或库存；服用它的佣兵若被杀死，便可再次获得一瓶。

units.source: The fatigue cost of the 'Shieldwall' skill is reduced by {#1}25%{/#1}
units.zh: “盾墙”技能的疲劳消耗降低{#1}25%{/#1}。

units.source: Playing as the {#1}Anatomists{/#1} origin slay an {#2}Ancient Auxiliary{/#2} or {#3}Ancient Legionary{/#3} for the first time.
units.zh: 选择{#1}解剖学者{/#1}开局，首次击杀{#2}古代辅兵{/#2}或{#3}古代军团兵{/#3}时获得。

units.source: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} The action point costs of the Rotation and Footwork skills are reduced to {#4} 2 {/#4}
{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} The fatigue costs of the Rotation and Footwork skills are reduced by {#4} 50% {/#4}
{#1}Developed from drugs found on goblin frontline troops, this concoction can grant a man the celerity typically found in the diminutive greenskins. May result in minor skin discolouration.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}这剂药液由地精前线部队携带的药物研制而成，能赋予人类那些矮小绿皮特有的敏捷身手。可能导致皮肤轻微变色。{/#1}

units.source: Playing as the {#1}Anatomists{/#1} origin slay a {#2}Goblin Skirmisher{/#2}, {#3}Goblin Ambusher{/#3} or {#4}Goblin Wolfrider{/#4} for the first time.
units.zh: 选择{#1}解剖学者{/#1}开局，首次击杀{#2}地精游击兵{/#2}、{#3}地精伏击手{/#3}或{#4}地精狼骑兵{/#4}时获得。

units.source: {#1}Feel the strength of an orc flow through your veins! Imbibing this draft will infuse even the meekest man's blows with the intense destructive power of a hulking greenskin, gauranteed!{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}感受兽人的力量在血管中奔流！服下这剂药液，即使最懦弱的人，也能打出壮硕绿皮那般惊人的破坏力，保证有效！{/#1}

units.source: Playing as the {#1}Anatomists{/#1} origin slay an {#2}Orc Young{/#2} for the first time.
units.zh: 以{#1}解剖学者{/#1}起源游玩时，首次击杀{#2}兽人青年{/#2}后获得。

units.source: Gain 3 stacks of {#1}Rage{/#1} up to a maximum of 15 stacks upon taking hitpoint damage, which increases Resolve, Initiative, damage dealt, and reduces damage taken
units.zh: 受到生命伤害时获得 3 层{#1}怒火{/#1}，最多叠加 15 层；怒火会提高意志、先攻和造成的伤害，并降低受到的伤害。

units.source: {#1}Developed from the adrenal glands of so called Orc 'Beserkers', this concoction is so named for the heightened emotional state and reddened hue of whoever drinks it.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}这剂药液取材于所谓兽人“狂战士”的肾上腺。服用者会情绪亢奋、皮肤泛红，因此得名。{/#1}

units.source: Playing as the {#1}Anatomists{/#1} origin slay a {#2}Orc Berserker{/#2} for the first time.
units.zh: 以{#1}解剖学者{/#1}起源游玩时，首次击杀{#2}兽人狂战士{/#2}后获得。

units.source: Does not trigger from indirect damage, such as bleeding
units.zh: 流血等间接伤害不会触发该效果。

units.source: The stacks provide the same benefits as the Beserkers {#1}Rage{/#1}
units.zh: 每层效果提供的加成，与兽人狂战士的{#1}怒火{/#1}相同。

units.source: Attacks that miss have{#1} 50% {/#1}of their fatiugue cost refunded
units.zh: 攻击未命中时，返还该次攻击{#1}50%{/#1}的疲劳消耗。

units.source: {#1}This humoural concoction, borne from research into the dreaded direwolf, will turn even the clumsiet oaf into a lithe dancer of a warrior, able to gracefully move with the tides of battle long after lesser men succumb to fatigue! Mild akathisia after consuming is normal and expected.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}这剂体液药剂源自对可怕恐狼的研究，能让最笨拙的家伙也化为身姿轻盈的战士。旁人早已精疲力竭，他仍能随战局进退，游刃有余！服用后轻微坐立不安属于正常且预期中的反应。{/#1}

units.source: Playing as the {#1}Anatomists{/#1} origin slay a {#2}Direwolf{/#2} or {#3}Frenzied Direwolf{/#3} for the first time.
units.zh: 选择{#1}解剖学者{/#1}开局，首次击杀{#2}恐狼{/#2}或{#3}狂暴恐狼{/#3}时获得。

units.source: Killing wolves that goblins ride or wardogs will not yield this potion
units.zh: 击杀地精的坐骑狼或战犬，不会获得这种药剂。

units.source: Playing as the {#1}Anatomists{/#1} origin slay a {#2}Hexe{/#2} for the first time.
units.zh: 以{#1}解剖学者{/#1}起源游玩时，首次击杀{#2}女巫{/#2}后获得。

units.source: Only one potion of this kind can be acquired and used. However, if the mercenary, who consumed this potion, gets killed, the potion can be acquired and used again
units.zh: 这种药剂只能获得并使用一份。不过，服用它的佣兵若被杀死，就可以再次获取并使用。

units.source: {#1}33% {/#1}to resist the Dazed, Staggered, Stunned, Distracted and Withered status effects
units.zh: 有{#1}33%{/#1}概率抵抗恍惚、踉跄、眩晕、分心和凋萎状态。

units.source: {#1}As any veteran of the battle of many names can attest, to fight an orc warrior is to fight a veritable wall of metal and flesh, seemingly impervious to even the most debilitating of blows. With this potion, now you can be that wall!{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}那场名字众多的大战，任何幸存老兵都能作证：与兽人战士交手，就像在对付一道血肉与钢铁铸成的高墙，连足以使人失去战斗力的重击似乎都奈何不了它。服下这瓶药剂，你也能成为那道高墙！{/#1}

units.source: Playing as the {#1}Anatomists{/#1} origin slay an {#2}Orc Warrior{/#2} for the first time.
units.zh: 以{#1}解剖学者{/#1}起源游玩时，首次击杀{#2}兽人战士{/#2}后获得。

units.source: An additional{#1} 5% {/#1}of damage ignores armour when using bows or crossbows
units.zh: 使用弓或弩时，额外{#1}5%{/#1}的伤害无视护甲。

units.source: Playing as the {#1}Anatomists{/#1} origin slay a {#2}Goblin Overseer{/#2} for the first time.
units.zh: 以{#1}解剖学者{/#1}起源游玩时，首次击杀{#2}地精督军{/#2}后获得。

units.source: {#1}This draft, the result of intensive study into the so-called 'Third-eye' of the Alp, allows whomever drinks it to see through the night as if it were day! Blurry vision and hallucinations are expected while the body acclimates.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}深入研究梦魇所谓的“第三只眼”后，研究者制成了这剂药液，让饮用者在夜间也能视物如昼！身体适应期间，出现视线模糊和幻觉属于预期反应。{/#1}

units.source: Playing as the {#1}Anatomists{/#1} origin slay a {#2}Alp{/#2} for the first time.
units.zh: 以{#1}解剖学者{/#1}起源游玩时，首次击杀{#2}梦魇{/#2}后获得。

units.source: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} Reduces the time it takes to heal from any injury by one day, to a minimum of one day
units.zh: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}所有伤势的恢复时间缩短一天，但最少仍需一天。

units.source: Playing as the {#1}Anatomists{/#1} origin slay a {#2}Nachzehrer{/#2} for the first time.
units.zh: 以{#1}解剖学者{/#1}起源游玩时，首次击杀{#2}食尸鬼{/#2}后获得。

units.source: {#1}Of the many weapons at a man's disposal, the most deadly is surely his mind, and in no figure is this more apparent than dreaded necromancer. With this mixture, that frightful intellect can descend to the grasp of even the common man!{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}人所能掌握的诸多武器中，最致命的无疑是头脑，而可怕的死灵法师最能证明这一点。有了这剂药液，就连凡夫俗子也能掌握那令人胆寒的智慧！{/#1}

units.source: Playing as the {#1}Anatomists{/#1} origin slay a {#2}Necromancer{/#2} for the first time.
units.zh: 以{#1}解剖学者{/#1}起源游玩时，首次击杀{#2}亡灵法师{/#2}后获得。

units.source: Heal{#1} 25% {/#1}of hitpoint damage inflicted on adjacent enemies that have blood
units.zh: 对相邻且有血液的敌人造成生命伤害时，恢复相当于该伤害{#1}25%{/#1}的生命。

units.source: {#1}Whoever drinks this incredible potion, produced with the ash of a Necrosavant, will find themselves in possesion of the miraculous healing powers of the undead creatures! It does not grant the extended lifespan asscociated with the abominations, however - quite the opposite in fact. This may be considered a feature should the imbiber get a bit too comfortable drinking blood.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}这瓶不可思议的药剂以死灵学者的灰烬制成，饮用者将获得那些亡灵生物神奇的自愈能力！不过，它并不会赋予你那种怪物的悠长寿命——事实恰恰相反。如果服用者喝血喝得过于自在，倒也可以把这算作一种优点。{/#1}

units.source: Playing as the {#1}Anatomists{/#1} origin slay a {#2}Necrosavant{/#2} for the first time.
units.zh: 以{#1}解剖学者{/#1}起源游玩时，首次击杀{#2}死灵剑士{/#2}后获得。

units.source: Gain an additional{#1} +3% {/#1}chance to hit in melee for every ally adjacent to your target
units.zh: 目标每与一名友军相邻，你对其近战攻击的命中率便额外{#1}+3%{/#1}。

units.source: Playing as the {#1}Anatomists{/#1} origin slay a {#2}Serpent{/#2} for the first time.
units.zh: 以{#1}解剖学者{/#1}起源游玩时，首次击杀{#2}巨蛇{/#2}后获得。

units.source: Playing as the {#1}Anatomists{/#1} origin slay a {#2}Schrat{/#2} for the first time.
units.zh: 以{#1}解剖学者{/#1}起源游玩时，首次击杀{#2}树妖{/#2}后获得。

units.source: Accumulate no fatigue from enemy attacks, wether they hit or miss
units.zh: 敌方攻击无论命中与否，都不会使你积累疲劳。

units.source: {#1}This serum, developed from a substance found within certain extraordinary specimens of Wiederganger, allows a living man to gain some of the indefatigable perserverance of the loathsome undead warriors - with no loss of life! Some minor joint stiffness is to be expected.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}这种血清取材于某些非凡行尸体内发现的物质，能让活人获得些许亡灵战士那令人厌恶、不知疲倦的韧性，而且无需丢掉性命！预计会出现轻微关节僵硬。{/#1}

units.source: Playing as the {#1}Anatomists{/#1} origin slay a {#2}Fallen Hero{/#2} for the first time.
units.zh: 以{#1}解剖学者{/#1}起源游玩时，首次击杀{#2}陨落英雄{/#2}后获得。

units.source: No longer suffer any additional penalty for using orc weapons
units.zh: 使用兽人武器时，不再承受额外惩罚。

units.source: {#1}Many a general has wished orcs might be tamed, for if one could control the greenskins and direct their strength with the intellect of man, they would surely control an unstoppable force. With this, such fantasies are within reach!.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}无数将军都曾幻想驯服兽人：若能控制绿皮，以人类的智慧引导它们的蛮力，便能拥有一支势不可挡的军队。有了这剂药液，梦想已近在咫尺！{/#1}

units.source: Playing as the {#1}Anatomists{/#1} origin slay an {#2}Orc Warlord{/#2} for the first time.
units.zh: 以{#1}解剖学者{/#1}起源游玩时，首次击杀{#2}兽人军阀{/#2}后获得。

units.source: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}Turns skin hard and stone-like granting{#4} 25 {/#4}points of natural armour

{#1}With this potion, a common man may take on the aspect of that most frightful of foes, the Ifrit of the southern desterts! Gain the devils' stone skin and laugh at your foes as they break their weapons upon you! Side effects may include itchiness.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}服下这瓶药剂，凡人也能拥有南方沙漠中那种可怕敌人——沙魔——的特质！获得恶魔般的石肤，笑看敌人在你身上折断武器吧！副作用可能包括瘙痒。{/#1}

units.source: Playing as the {#1}Anatomists{/#1} origin slay a {#2}Ifrit{/#2} for the first time.
units.zh: 以{#1}解剖学者{/#1}起源游玩时，首次击杀{#2}沙魔{/#2}后获得。

units.source: Damage received from the Bleeding status effect is reduced by{#1} 50% {/#1}
units.zh: 流血状态造成的伤害降低{#1}50%{/#1}。

units.source: {#1}Brewed with a previously unkown gland from the savage desert hyena, this hearty brew transforms even the frailest man into a font of endurance. Even the most grevious of wounds will stop bleeding and close in a fraction of the time.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}这剂强劲的药液以凶猛沙漠鬣狗体内一种前所未知的腺体酿成，能让最虚弱的人也拥有源源不绝的耐力。即使伤口再严重，也会以远超平常的速度止血、愈合。{/#1}

units.source: Playing as the {#1}Anatomists{/#1} origin slay a {#2}Hyena{/#2} for the first time.
units.zh: 以{#1}解剖学者{/#1}起源游玩时，首次击杀{#2}鬣狗{/#2}后获得。

units.source: {#1}Feel your blodd boil! Or, more to the point, don't! With this tincture, the burning blood of a lindwurm will flow through your decidedly human veins, with the lucky subject none the wiser. Until they start bleeding of course.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}感受血液沸腾！或者更准确地说，你不会有什么感觉！有了这剂酊液，林德蠕龙灼热的血液就会流进你货真价实的人类血管，而这位幸运的受试者毫不知情。当然，直到他开始流血为止。{/#1}

units.source: Playing as the {#1}Anatomists{/#1} origin slay a {#2}Lindwurm{/#2} for the first time.
units.zh: 以{#1}解剖学者{/#1}起源游玩时，首次击杀{#2}林德蠕龙{/#2}后获得。

units.source: Playing as the {#1}Anatomists{/#1} origin slay an {#2}Unhold{/#2} for the first time.
units.zh: 以{#1}解剖学者{/#1}起源游玩时，首次击杀{#2}巨魔{/#2}后获得。

units.source: Any variety of Unhold, including armoured, will yield this potion
units.zh: 任何种类的巨魔都能提供这种药剂，包括披甲巨魔。

units.source: Always successfully able to escape from ensarement, such as from nets or roots
units.zh: 尝试挣脱捕网、缠绕根须等束缚时，必定成功。

units.source: {#1}While the phrase 'slippery as a goblin' hasn't quite caught on in the common vernacular, anyone who has fought the hateful greenskins knows the truth. With this amazing potion, however, anyone can take on this loathsome aspect!{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}“像地精一样滑溜”还算不上人人挂在嘴边的俗语，但凡与那些讨厌的绿皮交过手的人，都知道这话不假。现在，有了这瓶神奇药剂，任何人都能获得这种可憎的本领！{/#1}

units.source: Playing as the {#1}Anatomists{/#1} origin slay a {#2}Goblin Shaman{/#2} for the first time.
units.zh: 以{#1}解剖学者{/#1}起源游玩时，首次击杀{#2}地精萨满{/#2}后获得。

units.source: You can only have one of this potion, though if the brother who drank it is killed you can acquire another.
units.zh: 同一时间只能拥有一份这种药剂的效果或库存；服用它的佣兵若被杀死，便可再次获得一瓶。

units.source: Deal{#1} +25% {/#1}damage and receive only{#2} 75% {/#2}of any damage if hitpoints are below{#3} 50% {/#3}
Inner Sanctum resurrection occurs before the perk 9 lives if character has {#1}both{/#1}
units.zh: 若角色{#1}同时拥有{/#1}内在圣殿的复活效果和九命（9 Lives）特长，会先触发内在圣殿。

units.zh: 若一直持有这件武器，迟早会触发{#1}预言者香炉：弟兄们产生幻觉{/#1}、{#2}预言者香炉：全团噩梦{/#2}、{#3}预言者香炉：佣兵受惊1{/#3}、{#4}预言者香炉：佣兵受惊2{/#4}和{#5}预言者香炉：佣兵受惊3{/#5}等事件。它们会略微降低佣兵的{#6}心情{/#6}，冷却时间为 9999 天，因此实际不会重复触发。
